map.信息增益近似是做什么的？: What does Information Gain Approx. do?
map.如何使用信息增益近似？: How do I use Information Gain Approx.?
map.信息增益近似适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Information Gain Approx. best for?
map.基尼 = 2p(1 − p)；加权子基尼 = w_L·2p_L(1 − p_L): Gini = 2p(1 − p); weighted child Gini = w_L·2p_L(1 − p_L) + (1 − w_L)·2p_R(1 − p_R); Gini gain = parent Gini − weighted child Gini; entropy = −p·log₂p − (1 − p)·log₂(1 − p)
map.决策树分裂准则：基尼与熵都衡量节点纯度，取值越小越纯。基尼计算更快（无对数）是: Decision-tree split criteria: both Gini and entropy measure node purity, with smaller values meaning purer. Gini computes faster (no logarithm) and is CART's default; entropy is slightly more sensitive to purity changes. The splits they pick differ negligibly on most datasets.
map.增益 = 父不纯度 − 加权子不纯度: Gain = parent impurity − weighted child impurity
map.决策树分裂选择增益最大的特征。: A decision tree split picks the feature with the largest gain.
map.信息熵 H=−Σpᵢlog₂pᵢ；基尼不纯度 G=1−Σpᵢ²，均衡量节点混杂度: Information entropy H=−Σpᵢlog₂pᵢ; Gini impurity G=1−Σpᵢ², both measuring node mixedness.
map.信息增益=父节点不纯度−Σ(子节点样本占比×子节点不纯度)，用于决策树分裂特征选: Information gain = parent impurity − Σ(child sample proportion × child impurity), used for decision-tree split feature selection.
map.基尼计算更快且对错误分类敏感，CART 默认用基尼，ID3/C4.5 用熵。: Gini computes faster and is sensitive to misclassification; CART uses Gini by default, ID3/C4.5 use entropy.
map.父节点正类 6/负类 6，熵=1.0；按某特征分为左(5正1负)右(1正5负)。: Parent node 6 positive / 6 negative, entropy=1.0; split by a feature into left (5 pos, 1 neg) and right (1 pos, 5 neg). Left entropy≈0.65, right entropy≈0.65, weighted=0.5×0.65+0.5×0.65=0.65, information gain=1.0−0.65=0.35.
map.信息增益和基尼该用哪个？: Which to use, information gain or Gini?
map.两者结论常一致。基尼计算免对数更快，对多数类错误更敏感；熵对不纯度变化更敏感、偏: Their conclusions often agree. Gini avoids the logarithm and is faster, more sensitive to majority-class errors; entropy is more sensitive to impurity changes and biased toward multi-valued features, so gain ratio is needed to correct the bias.
map.为什么信息增益偏向取值多的特征？: Why does information gain favor features with many values?
map.取值越多越容易把样本分得更纯，增益天然偏大。C4.5 用增益率(增益/分支熵)惩: More values make it easier to split samples purer, so the gain is naturally larger. C4.5 uses gain ratio (gain / split entropy) to penalize multi-valued features and correct the bias.
